text:
Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: The institutional records office files ordinary documents by assigning sequential identifiers, timestamping entries, routing submissions through named approval channels, and retaining checksums of submitted forms for reconciliation against source records.

2) What occurred:
2.1 The actor duplicated the ticket manifest field in the digital ticket record on 2025-07-12; the QR payload checksum verification remained unperformed.
2.2 The actor issued four additional copies of the ticket manifest document on 2025-07-12; the unique issuance number assignment for each copy stayed unsigned.
2.3 The actor transmitted the copies through a third-party marketplace channel on 2025-07-14; the buyer identity verification step was left unexecuted.
2.4 The actor recorded a transfer of the original ticket record to the first buyer on 2025-07-15; the seat assignment release field remained unfinalized.
2.5 The actor modified the gate scan log entry to precede the other copies' scan records on 2025-07-18; the scan order timestamp audit stayed unconfirmed.
2.6 The actor submitted a refund status field marked "not eligible" on 2025-07-20; the chargeback arbitration sign-off was left blank.
2.7 The actor removed the secondary identification flag from the buyer account document on 2025-07-22; the identity re-verification queue entry remained unprocessed.

3) Materials/access observed: The actor accessed the ticket manifest field via an administrative account with elevated write permissions, the marketplace channel using a personal listing account, the gate scan log through the venue operations portal, and the buyer account document via the customer relationship system.

4) Indicators & artifacts: The artifacts include the duplicated QR payload checksums, the four unsigned issuance numbers, the unverified buyer identity field, the unrelease seat assignment field, the reordered scan timestamps, the blank chargeback arbitration sign-off, and the unprocessed identity re-verification queue entry.
